lines.en: label makotowinterbeach1:
I tap on Makoto’s name in my phone and wait for her to answer.
It’s been a little while since she asked me if I’d accompany her to the beach and...what better time to do that than a random afternoon in the middle of winter?
Yes, the idea of the two of us going there when it’s obvious she just wants to be alone with me rather than scope out a venue she’s already familiar with is a little...abnormal.
But I’m not going to throw away a vacation opportunity with a cute girl just because the conditions aren’t perfect.
Besides, I’m sure we’ll find some way to keep warm in no time at all...
I'm talking about sex.
That was a sex joke.
: Hello?
: Hey, Makoto. What are you up to right now?
: Right now? I’m just...hanging around. Why do you ask?
: Is now a good time to go on that beach trip?
: Uhh...no. Not really.
: Can you hold on one second, please?
: Huh? Uhh, yeah. I guess that’s fine.
: Thanks. I’ll be back in a second.
I hear Makoto put the phone down and start talking to someone (Probably her mom) about something I can’t really make out over the sound of a television in the background.
I remain on the line for several minutes and begin to lose my patience.
But just as I’m about to hang up and find something else to do, I hear her coming back.
: Yeah. We can go now. But...I want to meet there if that’s okay.
: Why?
: If this is about you throwing me a surprise party, I don’t want one.
: Why on earth would I throw you a surprise party? That’s obviously not what’s happening.
: Well then what is it exactly?
: That...will probably be easier to explain once we’re there.
: It’s already starting to get late, though. So if we’re doing this, get ready now and meet me at the beach in one hour.
: Okay?
: ...Yeah.
: I’ll see you there.
I hang up the phone and begin to gather a few of my things to prepare for an overnight trip full of debauchery and...probably smart people stuff.
I don’t know. Makoto will probably want to take a break between orgasms to brush up on encyclopedic knowledge or something like that.
scene wintersky
I send Ami a message telling her I won’t be around tonight and then promptly turn my phone off to avoid the barrage of messages she is sure to send me in response.
But it’s better off that she doesn’t know where I’ll be.
Especially since I’m going to be there with one of her least favorite people in the entire world.
But hey, that’s just how things are sometimes. And I don’t really want to think about it right now.
I just want to make it to the inn, kick my shoes off, and ruthlessly plow my class rep until she can no longer walk.
This is going to be a good weekend.
scene makotobeachintro1
I make it to the beach in just under an hour to find Makoto waiting near the spot where we set up camp for our last class trip.
if mayadorm35 == True:
A barrage of memories (The kind I won’t black out for remembering) come rushing back into my head, likely avoiding a collision with Makoto’s.
else:
A barrage of memories come rushing back into my head, likely avoiding a collision with Makoto’s.
Probably, at least.
I’m not really sure how her brain would rationalize the thought of an earlier class trip when this is still her first[school] year with me as her teacher.
I’m not concerned with that right now, though.
What I am concerned with is-
: I want to let you know in advance that we will not be having sex this weekend.
: Thank you for understanding.
: I wonder if the bus has left yet.
scene makotobeachintro2
: You’ve been here for thirty seconds...Surely you’re able to go at least another several hours without getting an erection.
: Ha. Funny joke, Makoto.
: Sensei, I’m being serious.
: I feel like the only times I see you, I’m either taking your pants off or doing your paperwork.
: I see no problem with this.
: The problem is that I want to actually relax tonight.
: Are you implying that you don’t find sex relaxing, class rep?
scene makotobeachintro3
: I can assure you that having sex with someone of your size is anything but relaxing, but that is beside the point.
: The truth is that there’s something I’d like to discuss with you this weekend.
: And we wouldn’t even be able to have sex anyway.
: Why not?
: It’s complicated.
: Girl problems?
: Sure. That’s one way to word it.
: You’ll see soon enough.
: Wait, what?
scene makotobeachintro4
: Don’t worry about it.
: The fact is, you’re here with me now. And the last bus of the day just drove off while I had you distracted, so there is no longer an escape.
: You should have told me about this whole no sex thing before I came here.
: You wouldn’t have come at all if I had done that.
: True. But look, I even made special preparations just for you.
I empty out the contents of my suitcase onto the sand, showing Makoto how much I care about her.
scene makotobeachintro5
: Sensei...
: Did...
: Did you only pack condoms for this trip?...
: Anything for you, Makoto.
: Why are there only three of them, though?...
: I figured that you’d be so into it after the third condom that I could convince you to just keep going without one.
scene makotobeachintro6
: I like to think I have a little more self-control than that.
: Says the girl who basically blackmailed me into taking her virginity at a Halloween party.
: Yeah, I did kind of do that.
scene makotobeachintro7
: But that’s in the past! This weekend, I want to actually talk to you about something.
: And we’re not going to be able to talk if our clothes are off.
: I mean...we could, but-
: No.
: I want you to treat me like a human being this weekend. I let you push me around far too often.
: Wait, like the whole weekend? Not just for an hour or two?
: The whole weekend.
: Or...I guess technically just until tomorrow, since we'll only be here for one night.
: Ugh...
: Listen, I understand that you like to joke around, but there is only so much that I can take before it starts getting to me.
scene makotobeachintro8

: So, with that out of the way, are you excited to spend some time with Makoto Miyamura not as your sex slave or class president, but as a girl who puts you on a much higher pedestal than you deserve?
I understand where Makoto’s coming from.
I obviously know that I’ve been using her for my own personal gain, but why in the world would I not do that when she’s made it so ridiculously easy?
I bet you’re thinking “because of common decency” or something along those lines, right?
I’m sure that sort of thought process will take you very far in life.
Be sure to call and tell me all about it while you’re sulking in the darkest corner of your bedroom and I’m sitting on a throne of naked [teenager]s with a glass of white wine in my hand.
And I don’t even like white wine.
That’s how far apart you and I are.
If something that I want is offered to me, I take it.
If something that I desire is within reach, I reach for it.
You just wait and watch things drift further and further away.
That’s no good at all.
Sure, there’s also a chance that this is misplaced narration and that you, too, wrap your fingers around anything offered to you-
Even when those things are dripping with so many negative connotations that it’s no different from gripping your own cock after putting it somewhere it doesn’t belong.
And if you are that person, then I like you.
Hell, even if you aren’t that person, I like you.
Just for this weekend, though.
Because even someone like me understands that you can only push a person so far before they can no longer give you anything.
And a relationship becomes meaningless once you have nothing to gain from it.
: Fine. I won’t take advantage of you this weekend.
: But you’re going to owe me.
scene makotobeachintro9
: Starting your marathon of niceties with a quid pro quo isn’t exactly the best first step, but I guess I’ll take what I can get.
So will I.
scene makotobeachintro1
: Should we start heading to the inn, then?
: I already spoke with the front desk and secured a room. They just need your credit card information or they’re going to kick us out come dinner time.
: Wait, you got the room already? I’m surprised they let you book it without putting any money down.
: It’s not like many people visit this time of year, so I’m pretty sure they were willing to go above and beyond to accommodate us given the circumstances.
: Also, it’s far too cold near the water to have just waited out here for you to arrive.
: So, at the risk of being any less direct, I will now say, “Sensei, please walk back to the inn with me before I freeze to death.”
: Fine, fine...
: Let’s go.
: Don’t come crying to me when you get horny and I’m not allowed to have sex with you, though.
: Unlike you, I’m quite good at exhibiting self control.
: Now, pick up your condoms and let’s get a move on.
I look down at the sand and notice how the soft ocean breeze has managed to lightly bury the condoms I bought just for tonight.
scene makotobeachintro9
: Uhh...
: Why are you just staring at them?...
: Because they’re already gone, Makoto.
: Gone like condoms in the sand.
: I think you’re looking for the phrase, “Dust in the wind.”
scene black
: And now you’re just walking away like you said something really cool.
I gaze up at the sky.
It looks like it’s about to rain.
A large wave crashes against the beach.
And comes to steal away the condoms in the sand...
scene makotobeachintro10
: Wow. You’re, uhh...really not handling this abstinent weekend plan well, are you?
: I’ll be fine. The idea of a vacation without sex seems strange to me, though.
: If it’s any consolation, it’s much less of me not wanting to and a whole lot of us just...not being able to.
: Right. Because of girl problems.
: Something like that.
: But even if we were to do those sorts of things together, it wouldn’t change how I’d still see this as the perfect opportunity for you to be nice to me for once.
: It’s rather bothersome watching you treat Ami like an angel and leaving me, Makoto Miyamura, like I’m some sort of-
scene makotobeachintro11
: Condom in the sand?
: Can you please stop saying that? It’s one of the worst analogies I’ve ever heard.
: Oh, come on. It’s not that bad.
: Fine. Maybe it’s not the worst, but it’s still unsuitable as a description for our...strange dynamic with one another.
scene makotobeachintro12
: It is kind of strange, isn’t it?
: If I were you, I would have stopped doing my bidding a long time ago.
: What’s the point of keeping it up if you’re not enjoying it?
: Hope, I suppose.
: Hope that one day you’ll realize how harsh you've been...and start treating me with the respect I deserve rather than the respect you can be bothered to hand out.
scene makotobeachintro13
: I really shouldn’t...but I look up to you a lot, Sensei.
: But I don’t want to keep looking up because that means you’ll always be looking down.
: And if we’re not on equal footing, neither of us will ever really be happy.
: Are you not happy, Makoto?
scene makotobeachintro14
: I’m fine.
: Just not very good at explaining myself, apparently.
: But I have an entire weekend to do that, so...
: I hope you don’t mind me being extremely intrusive and making the most of the short time we have left together.
scene black
She says, as if she’s dying.
We’re all dying, though.
It’s not just her.
We make it to the inn and I accompany Makoto to the front desk.
There’s apparently a discount on rooms due to this being the offseason, and it’s actually a pretty good deal for the type of place this is.
So good that I probably wouldn’t even mind coming back before summer starts, which is saying a lot given my tendency to pinch pennies.
Regardless, I pay the clerk and Makoto points me in the direction of our room, tugging on my sleeve to get me to follow her.
I oblige.
And our weekend of...apparently no debauchery at all finally begins.
